_why: A correction recorded only as a text lesson has to be remembered at copy time, and an old draft copied forward does not remember it. scripts/pipeline/external_slop_gate.py HARD-blocks any row whose pattern matches in scope, so it does not matter which stale draft the text came from. Copy this file to knowledge/retracted-claims.json and replace the fabricated rows below.
_entry_rules: Add a row when a correction retracts a claim that has already appeared in an outbound artifact (a CV, a pitch, a client doc, a post). skills/save/SKILL.md adds it at correction time.
id: short kebab-case slug naming the wrong claim.
pattern: a Python regex for the wrong wording. Bound gaps with {0,N} so a match cannot span unrelated sentences. Test it against the stale draft before saving.
retracted: YYYY-MM-DD the correction was made.
scope: 'cv' = checked only under --cv; 'all' = checked on every run.
replacement: the corrected wording, so the person fixing the draft does not have to look it up.
source: where the correction is recorded (a Decisions.md entry or a file path).

concept (optional): a list of regexes that must ALL match inside ONE sentence. Catches a reworded copy of the claim that the exact pattern misses (see the widget row below). Keep each group narrow and test it against the canonical replacement so the corrected wording still passes.
Never delete a row because the drafts look clean now. Old drafts get copied again.
